scope: Data freshness measurement query failure reporting

behavior.failure_metadata: Per-source evaluation failures store only a bounded operation summary and exception class.
behavior.failure_logs: Freshness evaluation logs identify source, optional location, and exception class without raw database details.
behavior.alert_state: Savepoint rollback and preservation of the last known alert state are unchanged.

focused_checks.regression: secret-bearing measurement query error is absent from result, persisted metadata, and logs

static_checks.database_or_delivery_access: none; synthetic connection and mocked query

limitations: No database or alert destination was contacted.
This does not validate production destination ownership or runtime retention policy.
